answer: A street trader licence with council market logs works as the gate: a pitch held at one market across many seasons. Each of 209 aliases needs its own pitch histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The ember check runs in the open: 209 fakes pay the full price 209 times, one honest agent pays once, and the delta trail in the ledger makes the velvet cost visible to everyone.
